Business Website Launch $2950

You can launch your business website for $2,950, with a custom design, up to 5 pages, and essential features like contact forms and SEO basics. On this site, you can learn more about the launch package, see examples of previous work, and get started with a 50% deposit.

How it Works for a $2950 Launch

To launch your business website, you pay a 50% deposit, and the balance is due at launch. The process takes about a week, and you get a custom design, up to 5 pages, contact forms, and SEO basics. You own the site outright, with $0/month hosting on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.

What You Get and Costs

With the $2,950 launch package, you get a custom website with up to 5 pages, contact forms, and SEO basics. After 90 days of free care, you can opt for care plans at $295/month or $595/month, cancelable at any time.

FAQ

What is the deposit for the launch package? The deposit is 50% of the total cost. How long does it take to launch a website? It takes about a week to launch a website. Do I own the website after launch? Yes, you own the website outright, including the code, content, and domain.
